newsitem.title: UK: Abbey boosts finance house with factor buy.
newsitem.headline: Abbey boosts finance house with factor buy.

text.p: Britain's fifth largest bank Abbey National Plc on Thursday added to the portfolio of its finance house First National Bank by acquiring factoring company County Factors.
Abbey did not disclose the purchase price for the firm which discounts invoices to improve the cash flow of small and medium-sized businesses by providing finance against outstanding trade debts.
County has assets of just two million pounds and made a profit of 646,000 pounds in the year to March 31, 1996.

Tim Ingram, a director of the Abbey and chief executive of FNB, said in a statement that the funding benefits County would see as part of the Abbey group would help the company expand rapidly in the fast growing factoring market.
Abbey bought First National Finance Corp in August 1995 and later added car finance company Wagon Finance and contract car financing company ELTON Holdings.
Consumer credit contributed 49 million pounds to group profits in 1995. The Abbey announces its 1996 profits next week which are expected to be around 1.2 billion pounds after 1.026 billion in 1995.
